overview_description: Read the departments configured in Exsited: list them a page at a time or retrieve one by its id.
intro: Departments are the organisational units configured in your Exsited settings, each tied to a division. You can list them and retrieve one by its id. This area has 2 endpoints, each available in all seven SDKs.
notes: **Departments are read only here.** This area lists and retrieves departments; it has no create, update or delete call.

**Some listed departments have no id.** A department can come back with `id: null` and an `href` that ends in `/settings/departments/`, and it cannot be retrieved on its own. Pick one with an `id` to read it singly.
**Department ids start with `dept_`.** Pass that `id` as `department_id`.
**The list pages by cursor.** Records are under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.

endpoints.title: List departments
endpoints.summary: Lists the departments set up in Exsited, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of departments under `data`, with `pagination` for the next page. Each department carries its `code`, `name`, `display_name`, `description`, `status` and the `division` it belongs to. Some departments in the list have a null `id`; those cannot be retrieved on their own. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a department
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one department by its `dept_` id.
endpoints.description: Returns the department under `department`. Use the `id` from the department list; a department whose `id` is null in the list cannot be read this way.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Rely on this rather than on `next_cursor`, which can still hold a value on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page.
